title: Enterprise Support: Remaining original payment available paid funds for retained-fee cash return
content:
Enterprise Support — Remaining original payment available paid funds for retained-fee cash return.

## Decision basis

For retained-fee cash return: Available original available paid funds is the magnitude of the selected posted payment minus posted returns and refunds linked to that exact payment, with other payments excluded.

## Hypothetical case

For retained-fee cash return: A hypothetical selected payment of USD 200 with USD 30 of linked returns and USD 20 of linked refunds leaves USD 150 of original available paid funds. A return against another payment does not enter this amount.
